uat.title: Read the entire Tableau metadata
uat.requirement: Tool must read all metadata of the workbook
uat.steps: Convert Superstore_Sales.twb; compare the inventory with the authored workbook
uat.expected: {"datasources": 1, "tables": 3, "relationships": 2, "columns": 21, "calculations": 26, "parameters": 4, "worksheets": 16, "dashboards": 2, "actions": 3, "hierarchies": 2, "filters": 7}

uat.title: Connections to Power Query
uat.requirement: Data sources must be re-created in Power BI
uat.steps: Convert the 3 samples; inspect partitions
uat.expected: SQL Server, PostgreSQL and CSV become native M connectors with server/db parameters

uat.title: Custom SQL with a parameter
uat.requirement: SQL must be converted
uat.steps: Convert Finance_CustomSQL.twb
uat.expected: Value.NativeQuery with query folding; <Parameters.Min Quantity> becomes an M parameter; lint findings reported
uat.actual: NativeQuery=True; parameter=True; findings=['Tableau parameters in SQL were converted to Power Query parameters (static at refresh).']

uat.title: Relationships and joins
uat.requirement: Data model must follow Power BI best practice (star schema)
uat.steps: Inspect Superstore and Finance models
uat.expected: Superstore: Orders fact -> Customers/Products (many-to-one, single direction) + Date table; Finance: physical join flattened with Table.Join

uat.title: Every calculation converted to DAX

uat.expected: 100% of calculated fields, groups, bins, sets and parameters converted; none needs manual work

uat.title: Table calculations (Finance, HR)

uat.steps: Validate worksheets: Fiscal Year Sales
uat.expected: All cells match
uat.actual: Fiscal Year Sales: PASS (16/16 cells match)

uat.title: Parameters

uat.title: Power BI project output

uat.title: Formula translator

uat.expected: DAX returned; syntax error explained

uat.title: Compare exported reports

uat.steps: Upload a Tableau crosstab CSV and a Power BI export with one seeded difference
uat.expected: Formatted numbers parsed; the single different row is reported

uat.title: Simple UI following design principles
uat.requirement: UI must be very simple
uat.steps: Playwright walkthrough: 4-step flow, responsive, dark mode, no JS errors
uat.expected: All UI checks pass

uat.title: Performance
uat.requirement: Interactive response times
uat.steps: Measure conversion and validation time
uat.expected: Conversion < 5 s, validation < 60 s per sample workbook
uat.actual: Superstore_Sales.twb: convert 0.01s, validate 8.4s; Finance_CustomSQL.twb: convert 0.0s, validate 0.4s; HR_Analytics.twbx: convert 0.0s, validate 0.3s

uat.title: Live validation (Tableau Server + Power BI service)

uat.title: Error handling
uat.requirement: Bad input must be handled gracefully
uat.steps: Upload a PDF, a corrupt .twbx, nothing, a path-traversal sample name
uat.expected: 400/404 with a clear message; no crash

uat.title: Known limitations reported
uat.requirement: The tool must be transparent about what it cannot do
uat.steps: Review WARN/SKIP checks and issues
uat.expected: Parameter-driven calculated column -> WARN with fix; custom SQL parameter scenario -> SKIP with instruction
uat.actual: Parameter is used in custom SQL: Power BI applies it at refresh (Power Query parameter); re-run validation after changin

uat.steps: Run full validation (4 layers) on the 3 samples
uat.expected: No FAIL / ERROR

data.dax_query:
EVALUATE
SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
    'Customers'[Region],
    'Products'[Category],
    "Sum of Sales", [Sum of Sales]
)
ORDER BY 'Customers'[Region], 'Products'[Category]

EVALUATE
SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
    'Orders'[Order Date Month Start],
    KEEPFILTERS(FILTER(ALL('Orders'[Order Date Year]), 'Orders'[Order Date Year] >= 2024 && 'Orders'[Order Date Year] <= 2025)),
    "Sum of Sales", [Sum of Sales],
    "Sum of Profit", [Sum of Profit]
)
ORDER BY 'Orders'[Order Date Month Start]

EVALUATE
SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
    'Products'[Category],
    "Sum of Profit", [Sum of Profit],
    "Profit Ratio", [Profit Ratio],
    "Order Count", [Order Count]
)
ORDER BY 'Products'[Category]

EVALUATE
SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
    'Customers'[Segment],
    'Orders'[Profit Status],
    'Orders'[Order Date Year],
    KEEPFILTERS(TREATAS({"East", "West", "Central"}, 'Customers'[Region])),
    "Sum of Sales", [Sum of Sales]
)
ORDER BY 'Customers'[Segment], 'Orders'[Profit Status], 'Orders'[Order Date Year]
